 Too hot and humid for a hike? Escape Bangkok’s heat without leaving the city at SUBSOLUM Another Yard’s latest indoor nature retreat with drinks and AC
 Written by Meena Janekrabuanhad Staff writer, Time Out Thailand Monday November 9 2026 Share Copy Link Facebook Twitter Pinterest Email WhatsApp Photograph: Subsolum.bkk | Bangkok Advertising Bangkok's heat has you hiding indoors? Another Yard at SUBSOLUM brings the countryside upstairs, with rolling green hills, drifting mist and drinks and light snacks from Newstand on the 39th floor of T-ONE Building, Sukhumvit 40 . The indoor landscape is due to open on November 14 , giving the Thong Lo area a greener-looking place to take a breather. 
 Between the UV umbrellas, sunglasses, sun jackets and generous layers of sunscreen, getting outside can feel like an expedition before you’ve even left the pavement. Here, the hiking boots can stay at home. So can any ambitions of conquering a summit (unless it’s by elevator). 
 The project follows SUBSOLUM’s Quiet Room , which ran until November 5 and invited visitors to do absolutely nothing among white floor cushions and sweeping city views. Another Yard gives the raw industrial space a countryside makeover, setting soft green contours against Bangkok’s skyline.  
 That distinction gives the idea a little more bite than another photogenic green corner. How much do we love nature itself, and how much do we love the version where we can turn down the heat? You can ponder that over a drink or simply enjoy the unlikely pairing of hills and high-rises. 
 Newstand is providing drinks and light snacks, so there’s something to sip while you slow down. After all, sometimes the best way to enjoy the outdoors in Bangkok might be to bring it inside. 
 November 14-December 9 2026. Must purchase a drink/snack at Newstand to enter, T-ONE Building, 39th floor, 8 Sukhumvit 40, Khlong Toei. Open daily 10am-10pm.
